name: PrimeVue · Vue Button Component

description.zh: 最后开 Button。import 语句和 Reject/Accept、Submit 都在。 PrimeTek 的 Vue UI 套件，现为 5.0.1。核心库走 PrimeUI 许可，不再 MIT；4.x 及更早仍为 MIT。Community 对符合条件的小团队免费，Commercial 含 Blocks 与主题工具。

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by PrimeVue (https://primevue.dev/).
Technology stack: vue, typescript, javascript, css.
Component specification: 最后开 Button。import 语句和 Reject/Accept、Submit 都在。

Visual details from source observation: primevue.org 跳到 primevue.dev。首页 Premium UI Suite for Vue，徽章 primevue@5.0.1。Installation 页按 Vite、Nuxt、CDN 分指南。Button 页 import Button from 'primevue/button'，Reject/Accept 与 Submit 示例。本条是 Vue 入口，不含 PrimeReact。v5 走 PrimeUI；4.x 仍为 MIT。侧栏 Charts、Scheduler 标 PRO SUITE，Community 不含这些。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).

offers.scope: Community free if eligible; Commercial $599/dev through 2026, PrimeBlocks and Theme Designer not in Community
